people.name: Circuit Designer
people.description: Designs analog/mixed-signal ICs; runs simulations to verify behavior

people.name: CAD / EDA Engineer
people.description: Integrates the simulator into design flows; writes behavioral models

containers.name: Netlist Parser
containers.description: Parses SPICE .sp/.cir and Verilog-AMS .vams into an internal IR; outputs circuit graph

containers.name: MNA Engine
containers.description: Stamps circuit elements into the sparse MNA matrix; performs topology validation (floating nodes, V-source loops)

containers.name: Device Registry
containers.description: Holds SPICE-compatible device model implementations (diode, MOSFET Level 1/3, BJT Ebers-Moll, R/L/C, behavioral macromodels)

containers.name: Solver Core
containers.description: Implements the nonlinear NR solver, Radau IIA and BDF transient integrators, sparse LU kernel; the performance-critical inner loop

components.name: Newton-Raphson Solver
components.description: Iterative NR with KCL convergence check and Gmin insertion

components.name: Sparse LU Factorizer
components.description: Markowitz-ordered sparse LU for inner-loop linear solve

components.name: Radau IIA Integrator
components.description: Variable-step Radau IIA (order 5) stiff DAE integrator with LTE voltage-domain control

components.name: Homotopy Engine
components.description: Gmin stepping and source stepping convergence recovery

containers.name: Mixed-Signal Bridge
containers.description: Threshold-crossing event detector; waveform-injection (transition/slew) for digital→analog; synchronizes analog timestep to digital events

containers.name: Analysis Runner
containers.description: Orchestrates DC, AC, transient, noise, Fourier analyses; coordinates solverCore and mixedSignalBridge

containers.name: Output Pipeline
containers.description: Writes Nutmeg binary, VCD, Parquet waveform files; exposes Python-callable result objects

containers.name: Waveform Store
containers.description: Durable waveform data between analysis runs and post-processing

systems.name: EDA Toolchain
systems.description: Provides SPICE netlists and Verilog-AMS source files as input

systems.name: Waveform Viewer
systems.description: Reads Nutmeg/VCD output files (e.g., ngscope, GTKWave)

systems.name: Python Analysis Stack
systems.description: Reads Parquet/NumPy output for post-processing (pandas, matplotlib)
